messages:
incident-bot: Pager S2 — inference-service (us-west-2) elevated 5xx rate >5% for 10m. Pager: @oncall-jordan. Auto-runbook: inference-5xx-surge.

oncall-jordan: acked. I’m looking. Pulling up dashboards and recent deploys.

sre-lee: I’m in. seeing a cluster-wide bump in 5xx and a scatter of container segfaults in model-runner.

devon: logs show repeated `SIGSEGV` in the attention kernel on a subset of nodes, then the pod restarts.

ops-jen: any recent kernel/driver updates pushed?

maria: no infra driver updates in the last 24h. but we did push a model runner image with quantized kernels ~3h ago.

oncall-jordan: ok, hypothesis: new quantized kernels + long sequence requests -> OOM/segfaults on certain GPU types.

customer-success-dan: CS report: 4 paying customers reported increased errors for chat endpoints starting ~13:50 PT. tickets linked in #support.

product-ana: rough ETA to mitigate? Customers are starting to escalate.

oncall-jordan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to the stable smaller model variant for 50% traffic 2) cordon+drain suspected nodes 3) roll model-runner DaemonSet to previous image on the affected pool. starting step 1 now.

ops-jen: doing drain: `kubectl cordon gpu-pool-42 && kubectl drain gpu-pool-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`

devon: applying control-plane route change to split traffic: `POST /v1/routes/split {"from":"inference:chat","to":"inference:chat-small","percent":50}` — applying now.

monitoring-bot: Alert acknowledged by oncall-jordan. Routing change recorded: route-split-4821.

sre-lee: after routing 50% to small model: 5xx rate dropped from 6.3% to 3.1% in the next 2m, but remaining nodes still showing segfault cycles.

maria: can we increase `max-model-memory` in the model runtime config for remaining model pods as quick mitigation?

devon: pushed a runtime override to reduce batch size and concurrency: `runtime.max_concurrency=8` and `runtime.default_batch=4` for the large model. change rolled to the cluster.

oncall-jordan: good — monitoring shows further drop to 1.4% in us-west-2. still seeing two nodes that keep restarting model-runner with segfaults.

ops-jen: node `gpunode-42-7` is definitely noisy, drains are in progress and pods are landing on healthy nodes. marking node for hardware investigation.

devon: collecting a crash dump from the model-runner container: attaching `core.gz` and kernel logs. snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T20:12:32Z] model-runner[pid=8743]: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7fb2a1d2 sp 0x7fff...
panic: runtime: out of memory
#0 0x7fb2a1d2 in attention_kernel_quantized(+0x1d2)
#1 0x7f9d3f4c in forward_layer
```

maria: we should revert that quantized kernel image where possible. can we rollback the runner image on a Canary?

devon: canary rollback started for pool `gpu-canary-1` to image `runner:v2026-03-12`. no errors there.

product-ana: customer-impact update: CS says one enterprise customer saw session failures for ~18 minutes, degraded for others but auto-retries recovered sessions.

customer-success-dan: sending customer-facing note draft: "We observed elevated errors caused by a model runtime crash; we diverted traffic and implemented a rollback; we’ll follow up with root cause and postmortem."

noncall-jordan: once canary looks good we will promote rollback to the rest of the pools. also adding automatic fallback to stable model for 100% if error rate re-escalates.

monitoring-bot: Canary rollback metrics look clean for 10m with 0 segfaults in canary pool.

ops-jen: promoting rollback to `gpu-pool-*` now via `kubectl set image ds/model-runner model-runner=runner:v2026-03-12 -n inference` with rolling restart. monitoring closely.

sre-lee: after rollout, 5xx rate down to 0.4% cluster-wide. memory pressure normalized.

devon: attaching follow-up diagnostics: stack traces, perf counters, and sequence length distribution that likely triggered the quantized path bug.

oncall-jordan: mitigation complete: routing reverted to normal, drained node `gpunode-42-7` isolated for hardware/driver TLS. customers notified.

product-ana: thanks. Please open a Sev2 postmortem and link the runbook for inference kernel regressions.

maria: assigning to eng-runtime (maria, devon) + eng-sre (sre-lee, ops-jen). timeline + RCA due EOD tomorrow.

customer-success-dan: copy of customer message saved to ops notes. will follow up with affected accounts tomorrow morning.

oncall-jordan: closing pager for now. raising incident ticket INC-2026-3140 and adding initial notes.

monitoring-bot: Incident marked 'mitigated' by oncall-jordan. If error rate >1% for 15m, pager will re-open.

-- end of thread --
